$comment: Catalog of HyperFrames editing-style skills. commercial: ok = permissive license, fine for paid client work with attribution kept; check = no license or copyleft, ask the author or keep usage internal; no = needs a paid license for commercial use.

styles.name: HyperFrames official skills
styles.look: The engine: composition contract, GSAP animation, keyframes, audio mixing, CLI loop, registry.
styles.bestFor: Install first. Every other style sits on top of this.

styles.name: HyperFrames registry (165 blocks + ~200 components)
styles.look: Drop-in shots: lower thirds, transitions, liquid glass, maps, charts, code, social cards, caption effects.
styles.bestFor: Grab single shots with `npx hyperframes add <name>` instead of hand-building.

styles.name: Vox explainer (community, HeyGen)
styles.look: Paper-collage 'hiding in plain sight' explainer, archive imagery, serif type, marker circles.
styles.bestFor: 60-90s history / 'why is X everywhere' pieces.

styles.name: Nate Herk student kit (your current one)
styles.look: Vox paper-collage + Kallaway smooth YouTuber style, 406 cards, dark graph-paper and glass popout templates, full talking-head edit pipeline.
styles.bestFor: Talking-head long-form and shorts; the style-library/ format is our brand-swap template.

styles.name: Vox director (Codex)
styles.look: Vox editorial paper-collage explainers AND ads with ImageGen stills, narration, music.
styles.bestFor: Topic-to-finished Vox piece, also works as an ad format.

styles.name: Paper Cut collage
styles.look: Image-led paper-cut collage explainers: AI hero stills split into layers, paper SFX, collage typography, 3 approval gates.
styles.bestFor: Science / explainer clients who want the Vox look with bespoke art.

styles.name: Halftone paper-collage infographics
styles.look: Beige paper field, cardstock cutouts, halftone, stop-motion; numbers, flows, comparisons. No image model needed.
styles.bestFor: Cut-in infographic beats for a voiceover script.

styles.name: Faceless explainer (official)
styles.look: Invented visuals per scene: typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz.
styles.bestFor: Article / notes / topic to explainer with no footage.

styles.name: SRT-driven editorial video
styles.look: Editorial-magazine motion driven by an SRT subtitle file, token-based visual system.
styles.bestFor: You already have narration + SRT and want editorial B-roll.

styles.name: Quiet Editorial UI
styles.look: Brand-neutral, serif-led, refined software/editorial look applied on top of an existing project.
styles.bestFor: Premium SaaS / consulting clients. Built to be re-branded.

styles.name: HyperFrame Pro (retention-linted explainers)
styles.look: Beat planning, voice-locked cues, and a lint that fails the build on dead air or weak heroes.
styles.bestFor: Faceless vertical explainers where retention matters (TikTok/Reels).

styles.name: Ghost Editor (7 reel styles + clone-a-reel)
styles.look: clean, editorial, meme, cinematic, launch, kinetic, pop. Can reverse-engineer any reference reel and save it as a new style.
styles.bestFor: Raw phone talking-head to finished reel. The 'copy this reel' feature is gold for client briefs.

styles.name: Embedded captions (35 caption identities)
styles.look: cream, ink, editorial, keynote, documentary, loud, neon, glitch, chrome, velocity, vhs, terminal, scoreboard, papercut, graffiti, ransom and more; captions can sit behind the subject.
styles.bestFor: Caption-only upsell on any client's footage.

styles.name: 3D camera captions
styles.look: Camera flies between speaker and words, captions at different depths, hero words tucked behind the speaker.
styles.bestFor: High-energy creator reels.

styles.name: Cinematic spatial captions
styles.look: Hero-word stacks placed around the speaker, translucent fills, subject-aware depth, restrained sound accents.
styles.bestFor: Premium brand / founder videos.

styles.name: TikTok/IG shorts pack (pop-out, kinetic captions, warm editorial)
styles.look: Presenter breaks out of a rounded PiP frame, word-timed roaming captions, Anthropic-inspired warm editorial art direction.
styles.bestFor: Social-first talking-head edits.

styles.name: Talking-head recut (official)
styles.look: Kinetic titles, lower thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP synced to transcript.
styles.bestFor: Podcasts / interviews / webinars.

styles.name: Vertical creator edit
styles.look: Editorial house look, A/B-roll cutting, eased camera moves, themed motion graphics, SFX, render verification gate.
styles.bestFor: Script + talking head into a creator-grade short.

styles.name: Interflow card-cut (20 visual styles)
styles.look: Talking head turned into card-based video. Styles: swiss, glass, glass-hud, neon-grid-hud, terminal, holo-iridescent, liquid-aurora, kinetic-megatype, editorial-print, cinematic-bloom and more.
styles.bestFor: Repurposing podcasts into card-style clips.

styles.name: Learn-my-style workspace
styles.look: Downloads a reference creator's video, reads every frame, writes a style analysis, then edits in that style; /feedback builds a taste file.
styles.bestFor: Onboarding a new client: 'make it look like these 3 reels'.

styles.name: FB/IG/TikTok ad studio
styles.look: Battle-tested direct-response ad structure, motion-graphics spots and founder talking-head ads, reverse-template workflow.
styles.bestFor: Paid-social clients. Easiest to sell.

styles.name: Facecam to motion-graphics ad
styles.look: Silence pre-cut, tight square + full-frame face crops, word-level transcript, brand palette lifted from the client's site.
styles.bestFor: One raw take to a Meta/TikTok ad.

styles.name: Product launch video (official)
styles.look: SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos from a URL or brief.
styles.bestFor: Startups and SaaS.

styles.name: Website to video
styles.look: Captures the client's site (colors, fonts, screenshots) and builds a promo from it.
styles.bestFor: Fastest brand-accurate promo: brand comes for free.

styles.name: Promo creator pipeline
styles.look: 6-stage product promo: brief, storyboard, asset packs, HyperFrames edit, BGM with beat-sync.
styles.bestFor: 60-90s product / open-source promos.

styles.name: Guizang release-notes film
styles.look: Reuses the real product's components and design language for update / changelog promos, original music and SFX.
styles.bestFor: Software companies shipping updates.

styles.name: HeyGen avatar mix
styles.look: Your avatar full-screen / corner / hidden over HyperFrames animated backgrounds, music, SFX, Hormozi captions, auto-publish.
styles.bestFor: Faceless clients who want a presenter.

styles.name: Personal IP brand intro
styles.look: Typography + original vector illustrations, beat-synced to uploaded music.
styles.bestFor: Creator / coach channel intros and logo stings.

styles.name: Code change to video (official)
styles.look: Changelog / feature reveal built from a PR diff.
styles.bestFor: Dev-tool clients.

styles.name: Motion graphics (official)
styles.look: Kinetic type, count-ups, charts, logo stings, lower thirds, animated maps.
styles.bestFor: Short design-led pieces where motion is the message.

styles.name: html-video frame templates (21)
styles.look: 1970s poster, Swiss grid, Pentagram stat, NYT chart, Vignelli, light-leak cinema, glitch title, liquid hero, warm grain, logo outro.
styles.bestFor: Title cards, section cards, data moments in a named design language.

styles.name: Motion video maker (react-bits text effects)
styles.look: 14 text animations (split, blur, shiny, gradient, glitch, decrypt, typewriter, count-up...) + cinematic backgrounds.
styles.bestFor: Slick kinetic typography promos.

styles.name: HyperFrames motion library (23 data templates)
styles.look: Stat duel, myth/fact swap, bar compare, line draw, timeline scan, top-rank list; transparent MOV/WebM export.
styles.bestFor: Data beats you overlay in Premiere/CapCut.

styles.name: IBRA motion pack (10 social templates)
styles.look: iMessage stack, Apple Maps route, trash-the-logos hook, app launcher grid, iOS toggle, stat counter.
styles.bestFor: Hooks for creator/agency shorts.

styles.name: HyperFrames motion director
styles.look: Cinematic promo films, keynote reveals, kinetic typography, article/README/website to video.
styles.bestFor: Keynote-style launch films.

styles.name: p5 paint animation
styles.look: Pencil handwriting that writes itself, photos repainted as brushstrokes, live clips repainted.
styles.bestFor: Artsy brand films, weddings, lifestyle.

styles.name: Hand-drawn ink film (day-in-my-life)
styles.look: 60-75s hand-drawn ink narrative film.
styles.bestFor: Storytelling brand pieces (adapt the story source).

styles.name: Whiteboard stickman explainer
styles.look: Whiteboard hand-drawn infographic with stick figures, voiceover, BGM.
styles.bestFor: Book summaries, coaching, edu content.

styles.name: Hand-drawn line reveal + coloring
styles.look: Black line art revealed left to right, then low-saturation color fills in.
styles.bestFor: Warm story shorts, NGO / charity clients.

styles.name: Manga storyboard narrative
styles.look: Consistent comic IP, dense static manga panels, zoom/pan motion, synced captions.
styles.bestFor: Story-driven faceless channels.

styles.name: Music to video (official)
styles.look: Beat-synced lyric videos, slideshows, kinetic promos. Music drives the pacing.
styles.bestFor: Musicians, event recaps, beat-cut promos.

styles.name: Kinetic MV creator
styles.look: Suno song to classic MTV or GSAP kinetic lyric MV.
styles.bestFor: Lyric videos.

styles.name: Duo foldable-phone comparison
styles.look: Two screens composited into a hand-held foldable phone: X vs Y meme/comparison videos.
styles.bestFor: Comparison hooks for brands.

styles.name: Omni video director (AI b-roll + VFX)
styles.look: Drop in a video; it plans beats and adds generated VFX and graphic inserts, assembled with HyperFrames.
styles.bestFor: Upsell tier: VFX shots on client footage.

styles.name: Super video maker
styles.look: HeyGen avatars, Seedance b-roll, OpenAI images, UGC ads, captions, QC in one skill.
styles.bestFor: All-in-one AI UGC ads.
